_units: metres in the extract_logic frame (x = actors.json x, z = actors.json z; runtime position[2] = x, position[0] = z). Metropolis frame: x + 16 (LOGIC_OFFSET_X), z + 0. Times in seconds (300 Hz engine).
_sources: fixtures/missions/<Map> (tACT/tSAC bytes), extracted/logic/<Map>/actors.json, Cfun decoded with scratchpad cdec.py/rpns.py; engine: dispatch.c 0x00421910, turret.c 0x0041bf90, turret_part.c 0x0041cf70, spawner.c 0x0044f2c0, spawn.c 0x0044f3b0, type14.c 0x0041f770

captain_count_rule.counts: live actors of type 8 (team turret) whose team byte (+0x18) equals the captain's own +0x18 (2), octagonal flat distance from the captain's home point (point_0c = its spawn position) < 0x200000 wu = 256 m
captain_count_rule.double_count: every type-8 turret is TWO type-8 actors in the live list: the turret and its base part (part_b), built by cact_create from the same tACT record (0x0041c08e -> 0x0043ada0 -> 0x0041cf70 -> base construct 0x0041a5b0 writes +0x16 = record type 8, 0x0041a59d +0x18 = record team) and linked at 0x0043ad70
captain_count_rule.excludes: type 36 (neutral or captured by either side): never reaches the counter (only 5/8/9/28 enter table 2, 0x00421aad; captain-owned type 36 falls out at 0x00421a15)
captain_count_rule.threshold: mode 2 (defend) is entered/kept while count < 10 and mode != 1 (0x00421d1c); in mode 2 count >= 10 and no far tank/Dreadnought -> mode 0 (0x00421eac/0x00421ecc)
